title: dedicated-autoscaler-priority-burst-util-reporting-enhancement
author: Priya Desai
description: Motivation: Improve Dedicated autoscaler behavior for mixed-priority fleets by adding token-bucket smoothing, priority-aware burst controls, and enhanced utilization reporting to make throughput guarantees more predictable under bursty workloads. This PR implements a policy layer that allows per-priority token bucket configs, integrates smoother transition logic to avoid thrash during scale events, and emits new metrics for fleet-level and per-priority utilization. The description below summarizes the changes, rationale, and rollout plan. Changes include 1) new priority_tokenbucket config and smoothing parameters in the autoscaler config, 2) routing adjustments so priority classes are evaluated before burst allocations, 3) new utilizaton metrics (dedicated_fleet_utilization, dedicated_priority_utilization, dedicated_tokenbucket_fill), 4) console dashboard updates and alerts, 5) migration script to backfill historical utilization tags for existing fleets. Testing: unit and integration tests for tokenbucket behavior and priority routing, load test harness demonstrating stable throughput for 2x burst scenarios, and end-to-end smoke tests for console surfaces. Backwards compatibility: default policy preserves existing behavior when priority_tokenbucket is not defined; migration is opt-in. Rollout plan: deploy feature gate 'priority-burst-v1' off by default, enable for a small set of Dedicated fleets, monitor the new metrics and alert thresholds for 72h, then ramp. Checklist: - [x] Implement tokenbucket smoothing and priority routing core logic - [x] Add metrics and tagging for per-priority utilization - [x] Console dashboard for utilization & burst controls - [x] Unit/integration tests - [x] Migration script to tag historic usage - [x] Feature flag gating and rollout plan - [x] Documentation and config examples See related work: ENG-4123 (priority routing design), ENG-4210 (utilization metrics spec).

review_comments: Ethan Park: The smoothing window default seems large (30s) which might add latency to reacting to real demand spikes. Can we make this configurable per-fleet and add a shorter default?

Lina Gómez: We should ensure metrics include fleet_id and priority_class tags to avoid aggregation ambiguity. Also add cardinality note in docs.
Priya Desai: Metrics now include fleet_id and priority tags. Added doc note about cardinality and recommended rollouts for high-cardinality fleets.
Marco Ricci: CI failed on integration test due to race on tokenbucket refill; add mutex around refill and add deterministic tests.
Priya Desai: Fixed race by moving refill into autoscaler main loop under autoscaler lock and added deterministic fake clock tests. Re-ran CI.
Ethan Park: Approving pending migration script verification in staging. Please ensure feature gate off by default.
